entry.content:
# Source Title Summary Topics Link
1 TechAsia Australian AI firm Firmus plans $5b IPO Firmus has two operating data centers in Australia and Singapore, with five more under development across Asia-Pacific. AI Read

AI Read

Semiconductor Read
5 DigiTimes Chinese image sensor maker GalaxyCore raises the stakes in high-end CIS GalaxyCore Inc. plans to raise up to CNY4.2 billion (US$627 million) to expand 12-inch CMOS image sensor (CIS) capacity and develop 100MP and 200MP sensors, doubling down on higher-value imaging after its first Fab-Lite investment took longer than expected to deliver returns. Semiconductor Read
6 EETAsia UVJC to Debut NovaJet Dry Thin-Film Deposition System at WESEMiBAY UVJC will showcase NovaJet, a maskless dry deposition system, as semiconductor manufacturing moves toward more flexible processing. The post UVJC to Debut NovaJet Dry Thin-Film Deposition System at WESEMiBAY appeared first on EE Times Asia . Semiconductor Read

8 TechAsia Meituan launches AI assistant for hairstylists More than 1.18 million users voted in Meituan’s hairstylist selection. AI Read
